query: SELECT cm.id, cm.slug, cm.title, cm.path, cm.totalLessons, cm.isPublished, COUNT(cl.id) as actualLessons FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id AND cl.isPublished = 1 GROUP BY cm.id ORDER BY cm.path, cm.orderIndex;
